cognition-mesh-test-chamber.description: Contained LLM suitability and behavioural profiling harness for model-host-task meshes, with mock-safe evaluation, negative lane generation, assistant-role benchmarking, and a local dashboard.

ef-engine.description: A barebones, inspectable Rust specimen of Entropy Folding: vault failures, triangulate recurring blockers, promote reusable constraints, and reduce future search chaos.

chatty-cog.description: Chatty-Cog is the everyday local-first desktop assistant shell for Chatty tools: local GGUF and optional BYO cloud models, sandboxed file work, modules, Bookkeeper context support, audit history, rolling summaries, active context, and trusted peer-to-peer handoff lanes.

chatty-edu.description: Chatty-EDU is a modular, local-first education assistant designed to run on-device for school trust and deployment clarity. No cloud dependency, no accounts, no tracking.

chatty-edu-user.description: First public user-focused Chatty-EDU release, aligned with source v0.4. Prebuilt Windows app for click-and-run use, offline-first by default with local data and no accounts.

reflective_identity_geometry.description: Reflective Identity Geometry (RIG): a v0.2 conceptual framework for studying identity-like stability as a possible property of recurring human-LLM interaction regimes, extending HRIS without claiming model consciousness, model-internal personality, or necessary human cognitive change.

Cognition-Scale-Formal-Taxonomy.description: A four-tier taxonomy for comparing human and artificial cognition systems by architecture, constraints, and observable behaviour. Defines LCM, LLM, MCM, and SCM as proposed classes for avoiding category confusion and anthropomorphic marketing claims.

cognitive_theology.description: FMI Polytheism-Monotheism Structural Pack v1.1: manuscript and public adaptation suite comparing authority distribution, canon formation, variation management, and institutional coherence in polytheistic and monotheistic systems. Structural analysis only; not theological doctrine, faith advocacy, or truth ranking.
